- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

PR unit-test selection currently allocates GPU runners before discovering that a bucket has no affected tests. Run selection on `ubuntu-latest` and launch H100/GB200 runners only for a nonempty selection or a full-bucket decision. GPU jobs execute the CPU decision without running Testmon selection again.

- Keep `testmon_selector.py` as the CLI entry point, with `testmon_plan.py` implementing CPU selection and saved-plan preparation.
- Read existing rank-0 v1 databases, select affected test files from recorded dependencies, include new/changed test files and mandatory mappings, and preserve recipe exclusions and platform markers. Selected files run with the existing production/experimental filters.
- Keep existing cache-content and PR-file validation. An unusable baseline or PR-file artifact produces a full-run decision on CPU. Setup and plan-transfer failures fail the check instead of moving selection to GPU.
- Do not reject CPU selection because Python sources or recipes changed, the baseline commit is unavailable locally, an explicit-file bucket has a different commit, or the image/interpreter differs. Remove the image-identity artifact and its build/workflow plumbing.
- Restore the existing gzip baselines on hosted CPU runners by disabling the cache action's zstd probe only during restore. Cache keys, schema and producers remain unchanged.
- Preserve full-run overrides, scheduled/merge-group execution, AWS/GCP H100 routing and GB200 labels. Missing coverage is accepted only when every expected bucket has a validated empty selection.

Baseline recording stays on rank zero, the cache stays at v1, and `testmon_cache.py` is unchanged. No new baseline inventory or recording hooks are added. The legacy distributed selector remains available, but PR workflow GPU jobs receive only `preselected` or `full`.

The CPU planner reads runtime fingerprints without importing the GPU suite or running the CI container. This has two limitations: changes used only by an unrecorded collection-time import can generate new parametrized cases that are not selected, and current container package versions are not compared against the baseline. New/changed test files and changes to recorded runtime dependencies are handled, but this is not identical to pytest collection in the target container. For example, changing only an imported parameter list can be missed if that import has no runtime fingerprint.

## Issue tracking

Incremental improvement to the existing Testmon integration; no linked issue.

## Validation

- All 210 targeted Testmon, cache, mandatory-mapping and workflow tests pass. The PR adds 10 cases in existing test files: six selector CLI cases, two saved-plan execution cases and two scheduling/coverage cases. No new test files are added.
- CLI cases cover empty selection despite image/interpreter metadata differences, changed runtime dependencies, new test files and new tests in existing files, mandatory selection, missing-cache/full behavior and explicit-file buckets at a different SHA. Runner and workflow cases verify that selection never moves back to GPU.
- Repository `tools/autoformat.sh` completed in check mode: Black, isort, pylint and Ruff pass. Its non-blocking mypy step reports 11 diagnostics for missing imports/stubs and an existing mandatory-test typing issue.
- Actionlint passes for `_unit-tests.yml` and the restored `_build_ci_container.yml`; `cicd-main.yml` retains two existing missing-required-`script` errors in integration-test calls. Shell syntax and diff whitespace checks pass.
- The gzip restore path was previously exercised with the pinned cache-action JavaScript against a local cache service. Run [39343659069](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/39343659069) also restored all 44 CPU baselines successfully.
- GitHub/GPU CI for this update is pending.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] I have added relevant documentation
- [x] I have run the repository autoformatter on my PR

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+name: Unit-test bucket
+
+on:
+  workflow_call:
+    inputs:
+      bucket:
+        type: string
+        required: true
+      platform:
+        type: string
+        default: dgx_h100
+      runner:
+        description: JSON-encoded runner label or object with group and labels
+        type: string
+        required: true
+      container-image:
+        type: string
+        required: true
+      sha:
+        type: string
+        required: true
+      timeout:
+        type: number
+        default: 30
+      unit_testmon_mode:
+        type: string
+        default: full
+      unit_testmon_target_branch:
+        type: string
+        default: ""
+      unit_test_pr_files_artifact_id:
+        type: string
+        default: ""
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  id-token: write
+
+jobs:
+  select:
+    name: Select tests on CPU
+    if: inputs.unit_testmon_mode == 'enforce'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+    outputs:
+      mode: ${{ steps.result.outputs.mode }}
+      has_tests: ${{ steps.result.outputs.has_tests }}
+      plan_artifact: ${{ steps.result.outputs.plan_artifact }}
+    steps:
+      # All selection runs here. GPU jobs only execute the resulting plan.
+      - name: Checkout
+        id: checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ inputs.sha }}
+
+      - name: Setup Python
+        id: python
+        uses: actions/setup-python@ece7cb06caefa5fff74198d8649806c4678c61a1 # v6
+        with:
+          python-version: '3.12'
+
+      - name: Install selection dependencies
+        id: dependencies
+        run: python -m pip install 'pytest-testmon==2.2.0' PyYAML
+
+      - name: Compute unit Testmon cache identity
+        id: identity
+        shell: bash -e -u -o pipefail {0}
+        env:
+          BUCKET: ${{ inputs.bucket }}
+          RECIPE_PLATFORM: ${{ inputs.platform }}
+          TARGET_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.unit_testmon_target_branch }}
+        run: |
+          [[ "$TARGET_BRANCH" == "main" ]]
+          python tests/unit_tests/testmon_cache.py identity \
+            --bucket "$BUCKET" --platform "$RECIPE_PLATFORM" \
+            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/unit-testmon-identity.json" | tee -a "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          BUCKET_HASH=$(printf '%s' "$BUCKET" | sha256sum | cut -c 1-16)
+          echo "artifact=unit-test-plan-${RECIPE_PLATFORM}-${BUCKET_HASH}-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: Match the baseline cache compression
+        id: cache-compression
+        if: steps.identity.outcome == 'success'
+        shell: bash -e -u -o pipefail {0}
+        run: |
+          # GPU runners publish gzip caches. actions/cache includes compression
+          # in its version and otherwise chooses ubuntu-latest's installed zstd.
+          # Make its zstd probe unavailable only for this restore step.
+          TESTMON_CACHE_BIN=$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/unit-testmon-gzip.XXXXXX")
+          printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n' > "$TESTMON_CACHE_BIN/zstd"
+          chmod +x "$TESTMON_CACHE_BIN/zstd"
+          printf 'path=%s:%s\n' "$TESTMON_CACHE_BIN" "$PATH" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: Restore unit Testmon baseline
+        id: baseline
+        if: steps.cache-compression.outcome == 'success'
+        uses: actions/cache/restore@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3
+        continue-on-error: true
+        env:
+          PATH: ${{ steps.cache-compression.outputs.path }}
+        with:
+          path: assets_dir/testmon
+          key: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.cache_prefix }}lookup-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          restore-keys: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.cache_prefix }}
+
+      - name: Prepare PR file download
+        id: pr-files-directory
+        shell: bash -e -u -o pipefail {0}
+        run: |
+          PR_FILES_DIR=$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/unit-test-pr-files.XXXXXX")
+          echo "path=$PR_FILES_DIR" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: Download PR files for mandatory unit tests
+        id: pr-files
+        if: inputs.unit_test_pr_files_artifact_id != ''
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@37930b1c2abaa49bbe596cd826c3c89aef350131 # v7
+        continue-on-error: true
+        with:
+          artifact-ids: ${{ inputs.unit_test_pr_files_artifact_id }}
+          path: ${{ steps.pr-files-directory.outputs.path }}
+          merge-multiple: true
+
+      - name: Select affected tests without importing the GPU suite
+        id: plan
+        shell: bash -e -u -o pipefail {0}
+        env:
+          BUCKET: ${{ inputs.bucket }}
+          RECIPE_PLATFORM: ${{ inputs.platform }}
+          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ inputs.sha }}
+          MATCHED_KEY: ${{ steps.baseline.outputs.cache-matched-key }}
+          PR_FILES_DIR: ${{ steps.pr-files-directory.outputs.path }}
+        run: |
+          mkdir -p assets_dir/testmon-plan
+          python tests/unit_tests/testmon_selector.py select \
+            --cache-dir assets_dir/testmon --bucket "$BUCKET" --platform "$RECIPE_PLATFORM" \
+            --source-sha "$SOURCE_SHA" --matched-key "$MATCHED_KEY" \
+            --pr-files-dir "$PR_FILES_DIR" \
+            --output assets_dir/testmon-plan/plan.json | tee -a "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      # Keep empty plans as evidence for the no-tests result and coverage gate.
+      - name: Upload unit Testmon plan
+        id: upload
+        if: steps.plan.outcome == 'success' && steps.plan.outputs.mode == 'selected'
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@b7c566a772e6b6bfb58ed0dc250532a479d7789f # v6
+        with:
+          name: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.artifact }}
+          path: assets_dir/testmon-plan/plan.json
+          if-no-files-found: error
+
+      - name: Resolve GPU execution
+        id: result
+        shell: bash -e -u -o pipefail {0}
+        env:
+          PLAN_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.plan.outcome }}
+          PLAN_MODE: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.mode }}
+          HAS_TESTS: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.has_tests }}
+          UPLOAD_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.upload.outcome }}
+          PLAN_ARTIFACT: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.artifact }}
+          BUCKET: ${{ inputs.bucket }}
+        run: |
+          [[ "$PLAN_OUTCOME" == "success" ]]
+          [[ "$HAS_TESTS" == "true" || "$HAS_TESTS" == "false" ]]
+          MODE=$PLAN_MODE
+          ARTIFACT=""
+          case "$MODE" in
+            selected)
+              [[ "$UPLOAD_OUTCOME" == "success" && -n "$PLAN_ARTIFACT" ]]
+              ARTIFACT=$PLAN_ARTIFACT
+              ;;
+            full)
+              [[ "$HAS_TESTS" == "true" ]]
+              ;;
+            *) exit 1 ;;
+          esac
+          {
+            echo "mode=$MODE"
+            echo "has_tests=$HAS_TESTS"
+            echo "plan_artifact=$ARTIFACT"
+          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          {
+            echo "### Unit Testmon CPU selection"
+            echo
+            echo "- Bucket: \`$BUCKET\`"
+            echo "- Mode: \`$MODE\`"
+            echo "- GPU runner required: \`$HAS_TESTS\`"
+            if [[ "$MODE" == "full" ]]; then
+              echo "- CPU cache validation or selection requires the full bucket."
+            fi
+          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+
+  run:
+    name: Run tests on GPU
+    needs: select
+    # CPU failures stop the bucket; empty selections never allocate a GPU.
+    # Explicit full-suite requests bypass selective planning.
+    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (inputs.unit_testmon_mode != 'enforce' || (needs.select.result == 'success' && needs.select.outputs.has_tests == 'true')) }}
+    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.runner) }}
+    timeout-minutes: 60
+    env:
+      PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK: 1
+      PIP_NO_PYTHON_VERSION_WARNING: 1
+      PIP_ROOT_USER_ACTION: ignore
+      PIP_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT: 120
+      PIP_RETRIES: 5
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ inputs.sha }}
+      - name: Run unit-test bucket
+        uses: ./.github/actions
+        with:
+          script: ""
+          test_case: ${{ inputs.bucket }}
+          tag: latest
+          timeout: ${{ inputs.timeout }}
+          is_unit_test: "true"
+          container-image: ${{ inputs.container-image }}
+          platform: ${{ inputs.platform }}
+          sha: ${{ inputs.sha }}
+          unit_testmon_mode: ${{ needs.select.outputs.mode == 'selected' && 'preselected' || 'full' }}
+          unit_testmon_target_branch: ${{ inputs.unit_testmon_target_branch }}
+          unit_testmon_plan_artifact: ${{ needs.select.outputs.plan_artifact }}
+          unit_test_pr_files_artifact_id: ${{ inputs.unit_test_pr_files_artifact_id }}

+def _changed_files(directory: Path, source_sha: str) -> list[str]:
+    # Configure validates API limits and paths before publishing this artifact.
+    metadata = json.loads((directory / "metadata.json").read_text())
+    paths = (directory / "changed-files").read_text().splitlines()
+    if metadata["tested_sha"] != source_sha or metadata["changed_paths"] != len(paths):
+        raise ValueError("PR changed-file artifact is incomplete or belongs to another commit")
+    return paths

+
+def _bucket_files(
+    root: Path, bucket: str, recipe_platform: str, changed: list[str]

+    import yaml
+    from find_test_cases import (

+        file_has_marker,

+        raise ValueError(f"invalid mandatory-test configuration: {error}") from error
+    all_buckets = [case for product in recipe["products"] for case in product["test_case"]]
+    bucket_files = set(expand_pattern(str(root / bucket)))
+    ignored = {str(root / path) for path in PLATFORM_EXCLUSIONS.get(recipe_path.parent.name, ())}
+    for test_case in all_buckets:
+        if test_case != bucket and is_child_of_bucket(test_case, bucket):
+            ignored.update(expand_pattern(str(root / test_case)))

+    if marker:
+        ignored.update(
+            path
+            for path in bucket_files
+            if Path(path).name.startswith("test_") and not file_has_marker(path, marker)
+        )

+        str(Path(path).relative_to(root))
+        for path in bucket_files - ignored
+        if Path(path).name.startswith("test_")
+    }
+    mandatory = [
+        str(Path(path).relative_to(root))
+        for path in mandatory_files(
+            [str(root / pattern) for pattern in patterns], str(root / bucket), ignored
+        )
+    ]
+    return tests, mandatory
+
+
+def _select_phase(root: Path, database: Path, test_files: set[str]) -> set[str]:
+    from testmon.process_code import Module, blob_to_checksums, read_source_sha
+
+    with closing(
+        sqlite3.connect(database.resolve().as_uri() + "?mode=ro&immutable=1", uri=True)
+    ) as connection:
+        # Keep placeholders in the known-file inventory, but use only executed
+        # tests for dependency selection.
+        fingerprints = connection.execute(
+            "SELECT te.test_name, te.duration, te.failed, f.filename, f.fsha, f.method_checksums "
+            "FROM test_execution te "
+            "LEFT JOIN test_execution_file_fp tf ON tf.test_execution_id = te.id "
+            "LEFT JOIN file_fp f ON f.id = tf.fingerprint_id "
+        ).fetchall()

+            continue
+        test_file = nodeid.split("::", 1)[0]
+        if failed != 0 or filename is None:
+            selected.add(test_file)
+            continue
+        if filename not in sources:
+            path = root / filename
+            source, source_sha = read_source_sha(path)
+            checksums = (
+                set(Module(source_code=source, ext=path.suffix.lstrip(".")).method_checksums)
+                if source is not None
+                else set()
+            )
+            sources[filename] = (source_sha, checksums)
+        source_sha, checksums = sources[filename]
+        if filename == test_file and recorded_sha != source_sha:
+            # Recollect changed test files to discover new tests and parameter IDs.
+            selected.add(test_file)
+        elif source_sha is None or (
+            recorded_sha != source_sha
+            and (not checksums or not set(blob_to_checksums(fingerprint)) <= checksums)
+        ):
+            selected.add(test_file)

+
+
+def select(
+    root: Path,
+    cache_dir: Path,
+    bucket: str,
+    recipe_platform: str,
+    source_sha: str,
+    matched_key: str,
+    pr_files_dir: Path,
+) -> dict:
+    """Decide on CPU whether to execute selected files or the full bucket."""
+    plan = {
+        "schema": 1,
+        "source_sha": source_sha,
+        "bucket": bucket,
+        "platform": recipe_platform,
+        "mode": "full",
+        "reason": "",
+        "phases": {},
+    }
+    try:
+        identity = cache_identity(root, bucket, recipe_platform)
+        validate_cache(cache_dir, identity, matched_key)
+        changed_files = _changed_files(pr_files_dir, source_sha)
+        test_files, mandatory = _bucket_files(root, bucket, recipe_platform, changed_files)
+        # Recollect affected files in both modes: production dependencies can change
+        # parameter IDs or experimental markers without changing the test source.
+        affected_files = set(mandatory) | (test_files & set(changed_files))
+        for phase in PHASES:
+            affected_files.update(
+                _select_phase(root, cache_dir / phase / ".testmondata", test_files)
+            )
+        phases = {phase: sorted(affected_files) for phase in PHASES}
+        plan.update(
+            mode="selected",
+            reason="selected on CPU from the compatible main baseline",
+            phases=phases,
+            mandatory_files=mandatory,

+        OSError,
+        RuntimeError,
+        ValueError,
+        TypeError,
+        KeyError,
+        sqlite3.Error,
+    ) as error:
+        plan["reason"] = str(error)
+    return plan
+
+
+def prepare(

+        or plan["platform"] != recipe_platform
+    ):

+        output = cache_dir / ".testmon-work" / phase / "selected-tests"
+        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        output.write_text("".join(f"{nodeid}\n" for nodeid in plan["phases"][phase]))
+        output.with_name("mandatory-tests").write_text(
+            "".join(f"{filename}\n" for filename in plan["mandatory_files"])
+        )
